faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Dell Inspiron 15 3000 Series (3541, 3542, 3543, 3551, 3558, 3559), 15 5000 Series (5542, 5545, 5547, 5548, 5551, 5555, 5558) and 17 5000 Series, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Does it come with the frame?
faqs.answer: Yes, this keyboard includes the surrounding frame.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this version includes backlighting to match the original. We also stock a non-backlit version for this series.
